name: trov
description: Trov — the team's shared context store. Bundles the orient→work→record skills (trov, load-context, record-session), the personal my-work view, the ticket-queue skill (tickets), the admin plan skills (read-plan, update-plan), session handoffs (handoff), the Prompt Library (prompts) and artifact pages — find, download, spin up, publish (artifacts) — and auto-wires the Trov MCP server. Connects by browser sign-in: run /mcp and choose Authenticate.
